meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把素材和想法剪成品牌宣传片、混剪、蒙太奇或多场景定制视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要制作多场景的定制视频,而现成模板覆盖不了你的需求
copy.tagline_en: Turn footage and ideas into brand reels, montages, or multi-scene custom videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a multi-scene custom video that templates can't cover

howto.what: 当没有专门工作流适配,或 BRIEF.md 设定 flow: companion 时,它会编写或编辑自定义 HyperFrames 合成,产出多场景长片、品牌片、集锦、静态循环、静态标题卡、素材混剪等。
howto.when: 当没有专门工作流适配,或 BRIEF.md 把 flow 设为 companion 时接管;全新创建需先经 hyperframes 路由。

say.text: 帮我做一支多场景的品牌集锦片

say.text: 按 companion 流程,把第 3 场的数字做成滚动计数

say.text: 把这段素材做成硬切、裁剪、重排的混剪

howto.when_en: Triggers when no specialized workflow applies, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Fresh creation must route through hyperframes first.
